method: Each tool was called by Claude Code through the live MCP connection (mcp__campus-customs-hw51__*), and the output was checked against direct sqlite3 queries on data/campus_customs_new.db.

tests.prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman wants 1 Classic Bulldog Tee (SKU CC-TEE-WHITE) in size S. Use the check_stock_availability tool to see if we can fill this order from stock.
tests.verified_against_db: inventory WHERE sku='CC-TEE-WHITE' AND size='S' -> qty=0, location='Aisle B'

tests.prompt: Ticket 103 needs 12 more CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies from Bulldog Print Co (vendor 1). Use the get_vendor_status tool to check vendor 1's lead time and whether unpaid invoices block a new order.
tests.verified_against_db: vendors id=1 -> Bulldog Print Co, lead_days=5; invoices vendor_id=1 -> #501 $840 due 2026-08-28 status open; desk.date_today=2026-08-31 (overdue, restock 2026-09-05)

tests.prompt: Ticket 102 is a rent notice from Elm City Properties for lease 1. Use the get_lease_details tool to check how much rent is due, when, and whether cash covers it.
tests.verified_against_db: leases id=1 -> Chapel Street shop, Elm City Properties, $2400 due 2026-09-02; cash_accounts checking=3400; desk.date_today=2026-08-31 (2 days, $1000 left)
